h: Holding Fast to Shabbos Through Torah and Faith

p: (יְשַׁעְיָה נו, ב) אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יַעֲשֶׂה זֹּאת
(Yeshayahu 56:2) "Fortunate is the man who does this,
and the son of man who holds fast to it, etc."
"who does this and holds fast to it";
"and the son of man who holds fast to it"?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יִרְמְיָה ב, ח)
"The kohanim did not say, 'Where is Hashem?'
and those who grasp the Torah did not know Me."
And the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 32a)
"Who are those who grasp the Torah?
not those who grasp the Torah?"
and it explains it as the Levi'im.
that the reason they are called kohanim
only for the service of Hashem Yisbarach,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (סַנְהֶדְרִין צט, ב)
along the lines of what Chazal said (Sanhedrin 99b):
to be a laborer of Torah."
no occupation at all with matters of this world;
their eating was from holy things of Heaven,
from the table of the Most High;
and even eating terumah is called holy
and it is also called avodah
"they made the eating of terumah in the provinces
like the service of the Beis HaMikdash."
And likewise there are talmidei chachamim
who are free only for Torah,
דְּאִיתָא (בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ כט, ב)
as it says (Ra'aya Mehemna, this parsha, III 29b):
the children of the King and the Queen,
וְיֵשׁ מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ זוֹכֶה כָּל כָּךְ
And there is one who does not merit so much
and is compelled to engage in work
"for I have made my deeds evil
he immediately returns to his avodah
they are called "those who grasp the Torah,"
their intent is for the sake of Heaven:
so that they can set times for Torah
and raise their children to be talmidei chachamim;
and they are called supporters of those who grasp the Torah.
who are free only for Torah,
the Name Havayah, blessed is He,
as it will be in the future
that each one will point with his finger
(as it says at the end of Taanis, 31a):
for had they been as they should,
Hashem would have been before them always.
שֶׁעוֹסְקָם בְּעִנְיְנֵי עוֹלָם הַזֶּה גַּם כֵּן
whose occupation is also with matters of this world,
they hold fast to the Torah
that is, at the very least
for when a person takes to heart
that the King of kings stands over him
the fear will immediately come to him, etc.
so why "did they not know Me,"
that they should attain knowledge at least
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
(as is written in the Ra'aya Mehemna, III 230a):
"He is truth and She is faith."
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יַעֲשֶׂה זֹאת
And this is what it says, "Fortunate is the man who does this":
and along the lines of what is written
"since it said 'you shall walk' and 'you shall keep,'
אֶלָּא מַאן דְּעָבִיד פִּקּוּדֵי אוֹרַיְיתָא כוּ׳
Rather, one who performs the mitzvos of the Torah, etc.,
'and you shall make atem' is written," etc.
עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
as the Written Torah and the Oral Torah,
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah:
And it says that one who merits to make
the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah,
as it were, as though he had made Me.
וְכֵן בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קי, ב)
And so in the holy Zohar (III 110b):
as it were, you make them," etc.
And the end of the pasuk:
"dwell in the land and nourish yourself with faith";
and it refers to the eating of Shabbos,
for they are called the meals of faith.
and they said in the Gemara (Shabbos 118b):
"'Delight' — I do not know what it is;
(Yeshayahu 58:13) 'and you shall call Shabbos a delight,'
say, this is the delight of Shabbos."
and engage in the toil of Torah:
הוּבָא בְּבֵית יוֹסֵף אוֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן רפח)
cited in Beis Yosef, Orach Chaim 288) applies it,
according to the one who says in the Yerushalmi (Shabbos 15:3),
whose eating on Shabbos is "nourishing on faith";
for on Shabbasos they merit words of Torah
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי)
as is written in the holy Zohar (end of Parshas Acharei Mos, III 79b).

p: And in the Ra'aya Mehemna (Emor, III 92b):
'and you shall do': this is 'zachor,'" etc.
is a place in which there is no forgetting,
and forgetting has no standing in it,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב צב, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 92b);
at the time of the giving of the Torah,
when it was said to all Yisrael,
(שְׁמוֹת יט, ו) וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי מַמְלֶכֶת כֹּהֲנִים
(Shemos 19:6) "And you shall be to Me a kingdom of kohanim":
for had it not been for the corruption,
they would all have been free always
only for the Torah of Hashem,
as it will be in the future:
and you will be called the kohanim of Hashem,
and the Name Havayah, blessed is He, always
as we said on the pasuk
"the kohanim did not say, 'Where is Hashem?'"
And this is the place that has no forgetting,
for it is inconceivable that one forget, chas v'shalom,
since Hashem Yisbarach is before him always.
And this is "'and you shall do': this is zachor":
that such a one merits to be
as it were, as though he makes Him above;
and this one merits to "make the Shabbos,"
(in the Pesikta and Midrash Rabbah, Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1):
"Fortunate is the man who does this":
for this refers to one who merits
to be a laborer of Torah,
"and the son of man who holds fast to it":
הַיְינוּ מִי שֶׁלֹּא זָכָה כָּל כָּךְ
that is, one who did not merit so much
and is compelled to be occupied in work
as came about after the corruption:
he is among those who grasp the Torah,
for when he has free time
he turns himself to words of Torah.
that he not forget, chas v'shalom,
and this is "'and you shall keep': this is shamor."
on Shabbos he becomes entirely Torah,
as they said (at the beginning of Tanna D'vei Eliyahu):
who are very busy on the weekdays,
so much so that they exempted them
from the berachah of HaTov VeHaMeitiv
"and the son of man who holds fast to it":
he holds fast to the holiness of Shabbos,
and then it will help him for the weekdays,
that his intent in his work be
to raise his children to Torah study,
and when he has free time during the week
he will turn immediately to words of Torah.
to be guarded from sin always.
This is because in the Gemara
so that it be nullified entirely,
with the Men of the Great Assembly,
who abolished the inclination for idolatry
who merits to be a laborer of Torah
for they can entirely repair the corruption,
and they are in the secret of "zachor,"
and they "make" the holiness of Shabbos,
Whereas those who grasp the Torah
who are busy during the week with their livelihood,
it calls by the name "ben adam."
For the corruption of Adam HaRishon,
and afterward he cast filth into Chavah:
(as they said in the Gemara there).
he should hold fast to the holiness of Shabbos,
in which there is a repair
and Shabbos, in the secret of the bris,
contains a repair for the blemish of the bris.
"And the son of man who holds fast to it":
will help him for the weekdays,
to be one who "keeps his hand
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רִיט, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (I 219b)
when all Yisrael are free for Torah,
they can hold fast to the holiness of Shabbos
among those who grasp the Torah,
so as to merit on the weekdays
that the King of kings stands over him
and through this there will come to him
fear and dread of Hashem Yisbarach
and through this he will be guarded
And this is "and the son of man who holds fast to it."
